draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.60, the 242nd-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 23rd of 25 at tackle. He went 261st overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%.

current.summary: Year 5 pro, currently with the Baltimore Ravens (practice squad). 10 career games and 1 starts over 2 completed seasons. Trending down from his peak: 0 AV in 2024 against a career-best 1 in 2022. Weak spots: approximate value 0 (0th percentile). Played 2 of 17 games in 2024. Versus the typical Year-3 tackle who played: 4.7% season snap share against a median of 56.6%, below the norm.
